title: A Pi account check finds its Z.AI key from an OpenCode login and names the file read when empty
description: On a running test install, a Pi account whose auth.json reads its Z.AI key from an OpenCode account's auth file passes its live check with the resolved key, and a Pi account whose key command answers nothing reports the file path it read.

steps.name: Pi account check finds its Z.AI key on a running test install
